scenarios.name: Export and restore a custom ribbon command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Part Tools custom panel is initially empty
"2D Sketches" is added with Large and Text unchecked and applied
the customization is exported to a new XML file
the command is returned to the available list and the empty panel is applied
the user imports the exported XML file
"2D Sketches" appears in the target list with Large and Text unchecked
the target has a pending-change marker
the User Commands panel is not yet visible on the Tools ribbon
the User Commands panel appears with a small command icon and no visible label
the customization dialog remains open without a pending-change marker
